# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities to: theslayerrway@users.noreply.github.com

Do not open public issues for security problems.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| latest  | ✅        |

## Security Features
- No secrets in repo
- Read-only by default
- Keys from environment only
- Self-evolving regression engine
